mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and the direction is determined by the level of FEDFUNDS (low = positive returns).
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, the 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized) signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises by > 0.1% and PAYEMS falls by > 0.1% over 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (defined by strong GDP growth and high consumer spending), the S&P 500 is overbought, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% and RSAFS > 500000, the 60-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO > 100 and increasing) signals robust economic activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where INDPRO is rising (increasing by > 0.5% in 3 months), the 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) signals an imminent policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1300) signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1300, the 5-day forward returns are positive.
